name: USSF-317
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: A classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
slot_b_text: That was SpaceX's 128th launch of the year, 747th all time. It works out to a launch every other day. No Falcon 9 has failed in 349 flights. Worldwide, it was attempt number 270 of the year.
